card.name: Small words in IV line flushing steps
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, the, in, a) in preparation and infusion instructions, right where a liquid, line or vial noun is expected next, such as flushing the line or pushing the dose out of the tubing.

card.writes: It suppresses liquid and fluid words, so it makes a following word like fluid or liquid less likely.
card.plain: It fires on little words in IV preparation steps, such as flushing the line, where the next word is a piece of equipment rather than a liquid.
